title: ANSI 60 % QWERTY — English
notes: Generated by the generate-lessons skill from the layout export of the test suite's ANSI 60 % US QWERTY board (scenario A of docs/learning/lesson-rules.md). Everything on layer 0 is taught; the board's layer 1 holds nothing typeable. The semicolon is a resting key and is drilled from lesson 1. Shifted number-row symbols come after the Numbers lesson, since they sit on the digit keys.

lessons.title: New keys: Home row
lessons.guidance: Rest the left fingers on A S D F (pinky to index) and the right fingers on J K L ; (index to pinky); the bumps on F and J tell you where. The semicolon is the right pinky's resting key, so it is drilled here with the letters. Space is the thumb. Tap each key and come straight back.
